reconstruction.text: Recreated as editable PowerPoint text boxes.
reconstruction.charts: Slide 8 charts are native editable PowerPoint charts.
reconstruction.illustrations: Complex panda/city/icon artwork is preserved as independently movable cropped image objects.

limitations: The source PDF contains one raster image per page and no text/vector layer.
Complex line-art illustrations cannot be losslessly vectorized and remain image objects.
Font metrics may vary if Microsoft YaHei is unavailable on the viewing system.
